lines: The Undertaker: Welcome to the Wake. Every day someone dies with money and no friends.
The Undertaker: Bring a Spirling, perform one art by the coffin. The mourners pay for tears.
The Fixer: Funerals are slow money. Bounties are fast money.
The Fixer: Bring them in breathing. Dead men don't pay their debts.
Coach Varro: Fine training. I make good Spirlings slightly worse people.
Coach Varro: Cash up front. Results... eventually.
